title: eruca vesicaria var. longistyla
intro: Eruca vesicaria var. longistyla, commonly known as Long-styled Rocket or Wild Rocket, is a variety of the Eruca vesicaria plant, a species of plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Long-styled Rocket include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Eruca vesicaria var. longistyla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
